{{Top|leg}}
'''Vyvya''' was the [[Socorran]] concept of giving back, either to a group or to society. The [[Black Bha'lir]] held honoring the vyvya to be one of their core principles, and members making the oath were expected to protect the reputation of the society and its members.<ref name="BSS">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref>
